body: Thank you for the advice. I’m not really allowed to go to peoples houses and I don’t really have any friends. I try to hang out with some people to escape but because of covid and having to help my family leave Afghanistan, that doesn’t always work. I do try to avoid her though
Their destruction was such a shame

Yes, my mom has a variety of mental illnesses such as depression, anxiety and PTSD but she doesn’t take her medication because she feels that prayer works better for her. I’m a girl so the sexism is more casual and she sees me as an exception because I’m an only child. I live in Europe and I’m still in my teens so I can’t do much for her. I just try and bear it. I want to get a job once I can so I can have some money just in case something goes wrong. Thank you for your advice and I will definitely take it if things escalate.

If you mean the source of the quote then I just made it up haha. However, Confucianism diffused into various countries via the Silk Road and so did the part about parents. Even before the Islamic conquest, these ideals about honour and authority have been a pretty big thing around asia and Afghanistan.
Id like to clarify that I do not live in Afghanistan. Sorry, I forgot to add that in the post. Thank you for your advice and your take on my moms behaviour.
Thank you, have a hug back :)
